plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 skin samples (6 AD lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, Salmon gene-level raw counts, 12000 genes) go through a QC pass that explicitly inspects sample_01's low library size (~4x below median) on PCA and sample-distance plots rather than silently dropping it, then a standard DESeq2 Wald-test pipeline (minimal pre-filter, median-of-ratios normalization built into the model, explicit Control reference level, apeglm-shrunken log2FC, BH-adjusted p-values with independent filtering) to call differentially expressed genes between AD_lesional and Control. A parallel edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design gives a robustness check; the DESeq2/edgeR overlap is reported as the high-confidence gene set. The DESeq2 Wald statistic ranks the full tested gene list for fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary, for mechanistic resolution of hallmark hits), with results collapsed for redundancy and leading-edge genes reported. A final report step consolidates QC diagnostics, DE tables, enrichment tables, and a full reproducibility record (session info, seed, package/collection versions).
